current_claim.text: Qwen3.7 is the current hosted/API generation recorded by Atlas; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B remains the current open-weight flagship in the catalog.
current_claim.text_zh: Qwen3.7 是 Atlas 当前记录的托管/API 主线；当前目录中的开放权重旗舰仍为 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。
current_claim.text_en: Qwen3.7 is the current hosted/API generation recorded by Atlas; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B remains the current open-weight flagship in the catalog.

overrides.open_weight_scope: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is the latest open-weight flagship currently recorded by Atlas. Qwen3.7 Max/Plus are tracked separately as hosted/API models; no open-weight claim is inferred for them.
overrides.api_scope: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lists Qwen3.7-Max and Qwen3.7-Plus as current Qwen API models while Qwen3.6-Flash remains the Flash model.

current_claim.text: Kimi K3 is the latest Kimi open-weight model recorded in the official catalog.
current_claim.text_zh: Kimi K3 是当前官方目录中记录的最新 Kimi 开放权重模型。
current_claim.text_en: Kimi K3 is the latest Kimi open-weight model recorded in the official catalog.

current_claim.text: Llama 4 is the current Llama generation, with Scout and Maverick as released open-weight models.
current_claim.text_zh: Llama 4 是当前 Llama 主线；Scout 与 Maverick 是已发布的开放权重模型。
current_claim.text_en: Llama 4 is the current Llama generation, with Scout and Maverick as released open-weight models.

current_claim.text: DeepSeek-V4 is the current DeepSeek generation recorded by Atlas, with Pro and Flash variants tracked across official API and weight surfaces.
current_claim.text_zh: DeepSeek-V4 是 Atlas 当前记录的 DeepSeek 主线；Pro 与 Flash 按官方 API 与权重发布渠道分别追踪。
current_claim.text_en: DeepSeek-V4 is the current DeepSeek generation recorded by Atlas, with Pro and Flash variants tracked across official API and weight surfaces.
